items.name: arabic-typography
items.title: Arabic Typography
items.description: Arabic font stack (IBM Plex Sans Arabic / Noto Kufi Arabic), taller line-heights and no letter-spacing for Arabic, Persian and Urdu text.
items.author: Zuanda Baransyah Putra <https://zuanda.web.id>

theme.font-arabic: var(--font-ibm-plex-sans-arabic, "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Arabic", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif)
theme.font-arabic-heading: var(--font-noto-kufi-arabic, "Noto Kufi Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Arabic", Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif)

items.docs: Load the fonts once. Next.js: in app/layout.tsx use next/font/google IBM_Plex_Sans_Arabic({ subsets: ["arabic"], weight: ["400","500","600","700"], variable: "--font-ibm-plex-sans-arabic" }) and Noto_Kufi_Arabic({ subsets: ["arabic"], variable: "--font-noto-kufi-arabic" }), then add both .variable classes to <html>. Anything else: add <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Noto+Kufi+Arabic:wght@400..800&display=swap"> to your document head. Then set lang="ar" dir="rtl" on <html>.
